defaults.backend: complete: clean-room reports derived from persisted workspace tickets, messages, labels and audit events; saved report runs, label-based CSAT rules, one-use hashed response tokens and a generated OpenAPI 3.1 support-route inventory
defaults.frontend: complete: dedicated support-reporting Operations route renders agent/team/inbox/label reports, status filters, saved runs, CSAT rules, local token issuance and recorded responses; every control has one dispatcher guarded by test_ui_wiring.py
defaults.database: complete: four additive workspace-scoped tables created by Alembic revision b2c3d4e5f6a7 (support_report_runs, support_csat_survey_rules, support_csat_response_tokens, support_csat_responses); no existing table altered
defaults.api: complete: one stable support-reporting API group (version 1, no legacy claim, external_calls=false, external_delivery=false) with 404/409/410/422/429 failure modes and named acceptance tests
defaults.permissions: complete: verify_workspace plus require(CONTACT_READ) for reads and require(CONTACT_WRITE) for all writes; cross-workspace ids fail closed with 404; every mutation publishes an audited event with external_delivery=false
defaults.integration: complete: publishes support.report_generated, support.report_exported, support.csat_rule_created, support.csat_response_token_issued and support.csat_response_recorded to NOVARA's shared event spine; no Chatwoot source, Rails bundle, hosted endpoint, outbound HTTP, webhook callback or real survey delivery
defaults.remaining: None for this row. Other unimplemented, restricted or externally blocked rows keep their existing matrix status.
